Six-week timeline

Tap a phase for the detail. Dates run Monday to Sunday; the design guide approval on Sep 18 gates the start of development.

W1

Discovery & content audit

Fri Aug 28 – Sun Sep 6
7 days

Key activities

  • Sitemap review against the concept build - view visual sitemap
  • Confirm product categories, page list, and photography approach
  • Review & approve design guide - view design guide
  • Content questionnaire issued - begin questionnaire
  • Confirm shoot date and site address

Input needed

  • Approve design guide · begin the content questionnaire · confirm shoot date and site address

Content & asset gathering

Mon Sep 7 – Sun Sep 13
7 days

Key activities

  • Collect product names, descriptions, and pricing rules

  • Gather heritage story, milestones, team bios, testimonials, stockist list

Design lock & copywriting

Mon Sep 14 – Sun Sep 20
7 days

Milestone - design guide approval

Fri Sep 18

Sign-off on the visual design guide (layout, imagery, copy tone) gates the start of development. Build does not begin until this is approved.

W4

Build & content population

Mon Sep 21 – Sun Sep 27
7 days

Key activities

W5

Review & revisions

Mon Sep 28 – Sun Oct 4
7 days

Key activities

  • Client walkthrough of the populated site
  • Collect feedback and implement revisions
  • Test contact form, WhatsApp link, map embed, and internal links

Input needed

  • Full site review · sign-off on copy, imagery, and functionality by end of week
W6

Final QA & launch

Mon Oct 5 – Fri Oct 9
Launch: Fri Oct 9

Key activities

  • Performance and SEO checks: meta descriptions, image alt text, sitemap
  • DNS/domain cutover, go-live, post-launch smoke test

Input needed

Content structure reference - Home
  • Hero - full-width video/image, one-line promise, primary CTA to explore products, secondary CTA to heritage story.
  • "Proven by time" - short trust statement plus CTAs to stock the brand or find a location.
  • Bajan treats banner - sweet bread, turnovers, pastries, linking out to products and recipes.
  • Who we are - founding story since 1923, three stat counters, sketch-style bread illustrations as decorative accents.
  • Numbered service list - Daily Breads, Buns & Rolls, Teatime & Treats, Convenience Store, each a one-line description.
  • Services grid - four flip cards, front shows icon + label, back reveals a short description and link.
  • Testimonials - pull-quote format shown above.
  • "A century in numbers" - four large animated counters.
  • Contact / stockist form - name, business name, email, phone, message, with a same-page confirmation state.
  • Footer - logo, social links, sitemap columns, headquarters address with embedded map, tagline.
Content structure reference - Heritage & Community
  • Hero - "Our Heritage" eyebrow, H1 statement, short intro, single storefront photo.
  • "Our Journey" timeline - three milestones (1923 opening, 1960 expansion, 1995 third generation), each a year eyebrow, title, story paragraph, and photo - see milestone pattern above.
  • "Our People" - team cards using the same initials-avatar pattern as testimonials, with name, role, and short bio.
  • "Sharing Warmth" - community statement paired with an embedded Instagram feed preview (profile stats plus a grid of recent posts).
  • Closing CTA - "Join our community" banner linking to the Stock Zephirin's contact page.
  • Footer - identical to Home.
Built from the homepage (concept8_c and its live screenshots) and the Heritage & Community page (about8). Orange, deep orange, and yellow are confirmed exact tokens from the site's own design system; white, cream, ink, and line remain visually sampled pending the full stylesheet. Remaining interior pages - Bakery, Convenience Store, Recipes, Locator, Careers, Contact - appear to follow the same nav, button, and component patterns shown above; page-by-page detail will be added here as each is reviewed.
